mapper.select: SELECT W.STOCK_ID ,S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME ,L.TRADE_DATE ,L.CLOSE_PRICE ,L.CLOSE_PRICE - L.PREV_CLOSE AS CHANGE_AMOUNT ,ROUND((L.CLOSE_PRICE - L.PREV_CLOSE) / L.PREV_CLOSE * 100, 2) AS CHANGE_RATE FROM T_WATCHLIST W JOIN T_STOCK S ON S.ID = W.STOCK_ID LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN X.RN = 1 THEN X.TRADE_DATE END) AS TRADE_DATE ,MAX(CASE WHEN X.RN = 1 THEN X.CLOSE_PRICE END) AS CLOSE_PRICE ,MAX(CASE WHEN X.RN = 2 THEN X.CLOSE_PRICE END) AS PREV_CLOSE FROM ( SELECT P.TRADE_DATE ,P.CLOSE_PRICE ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE DESC) AS RN FROM T_STOCK_PRICE P WHERE 1=1 AND P.STOCK_ID = W.STOCK_ID ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE DESC LIMIT 2 ) X ) L ON TRUE WHERE 1=1 AND W.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY W.CREATED_AT
